subject: Renewal: capacity uplift + temporary price hold request
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Shah <m.shah@zypheria.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: capacity uplift + temporary price hold request

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the open conversation last week. Per our call, Zypheria is seeing a predictable spike across two of your product teams and expects roughly a 40% increase in token consumption over the next 12 months. You mentioned wanting predictability on unit price while you ramp.

High level ask from Zypheria we heard:
- Increase committed monthly capacity (baseline commit) to cover expected growth
- 3–6 month temporary price hold at current host rates while customers onboard
- One-time ramp credit to smooth month-1 spikes

To move fast, can you confirm: (1) target committed uplift percentage you can commit to (2) which date you want the change to take effect, and (3) who from procurement should be looped in so we can get a clean amendment drafted?

I've attached your Q1 usage export so our finance/ops team can baseline the numbers (zypheria_usage_Q1_2027.csv). Once you confirm the uplift and effective date, I can circulate a short amendment and suggested credit schedule.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if that helps close the details.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: zypheria_usage_Q1_2027.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Maya Shah <m.shah@zypheria.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@zypheria.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity uplift + temporary price hold request

Hi Laura —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear summary. A couple quick items from our side:

1) Uplift: We'd be comfortable committing to a 50% increase on our current monthly commit for the first 9 months if we can secure a 6-month price hold at our current effective per-token rate. After month 9 we can re-evaluate based on actual consumption.
2) Effective date: Ideally the uplift would start 2027-06-01 to align with our quarter planning.
3) Procurement & Legal: Looping Carlos (copied) who handles amendments and signatures. He'll want a single-page amendment and a clear description of credits in the exhibit.

One constraint: we have a procurement budget window that closes on 2027-06-10, so we need a signed amendment before that date to secure funding. Also, any credits we accept should be reflected as a dollar-credit line item and not an opaque offset to rate calculations.

If you can share a draft amendment and a short schedule showing how credits are applied month-by-month, we can review with legal and get back quickly.

Best,
Maya
Maya Shah
Head of Platform | Zypheria
m.shah@zypheria.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Shah <m.shah@zypheria.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity uplift + temporary price hold request

Maya —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. We can accommodate the ask and have sketched a binding proposal below to align with your procurement window. If this works, Marissa will shepherd the commercial amendment and David will coordinate legal redlines.

Proposal (summary):
- Commit uplift: 50% increase to baseline monthly commit, effective 2027-06-01
- Price hold: 6-month hold (2027-06-01 through 2027-11-30) at Zypheria's current effective per-token rate
- Ramp credit: $120,000 one-time credit applied pro-rata across the first three billing cycles post-uplift (Jun, Jul, Aug) to offset onboarding spike; credit will appear as a dollar-line item on each invoice
- Post-hold terms: After 2027-11-30, we will transition to the standard published tiered rates. We will provide a 30-day notice before rate changes take effect.
- Term & payment: We suggest an amendment that extends the current term by 12 months from the uplift effective date to preserve negotiated economics. Payment cadence remains monthly.

Operational notes:
- We can provide a simple one-page amendment + exhibit that lists the commit numbers and credit schedule. I'll attach a redline (see redline_amendment_v1.pdf) — it's short.
- If Zypheria needs faster execution, we can take signatures via DocuSign and lock the procurement window.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm you accept the summary above by EOD 2027-05-06 so we can route the amendment to Carlos for signature before 2027-06-10.
2) If accepted, I'll circulate the amendment and the invoice schedule and set a 15-minute alignment call with our finance ops.

Want to be pragmatic here — we're ready to prioritize this on our side.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachments: redline_amendment_v1.pdf (PDF, 92KB)

From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@zypheria.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Shah <m.shah@zypheria.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity uplift + temporary price hold request

Laura / Marissa —

Thanks for the concise proposal. Zypheria accepts the commercial summary subject to the following minor edits in the amendment: (1) explicitly list the $120,000 credit and its monthly allocation (Jun $40k, Jul $40k, Aug $40k), (2) confirm both parties' right to terminate for cause under the existing agreement (we'll accept the extension term), and (3) include a clause that the price hold does not cover usage above the committed uplift (excess usage billed at published overage rates).

If you can send a DocuSign-ready amendment with those three items, we will get this signed and returned before 2027-06-10. I'll coordinate internally to make sure legal counters quickly.

Once we have the DocuSign envelope, please CC me on the routing and I'll ensure procurement signs within the funding window.

Carlos Ruiz
Procurement Manager | Zypheria
c.ruiz@zypheria.com | +1 (212) 555-0146
